title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Levels: Verification and Turnaround Schedule
content:
Larkspur Home Lending issues the Mortgage Pre-Approval at six levels. Each level fixes which checks are performed before a pre-approval is issued, how many business days issue takes once the request is complete, and the fee charged for the pre-approval itself. This schedule states those values for every level.

## Schedule A: checks performed before issue

| Level | Credit inquiry made | Borrower's consent to a hard inquiry must be recorded | Income documents reviewed before issue | Asset statements reviewed before issue | Automated underwriting findings run before issue | Underwriter signs the approval before issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | soft | No | No | No | No | No |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | hard | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | hard | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | hard | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | hard | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | hard | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column definitions:

- **Credit inquiry made**: the kind of credit inquiry made for the level, either soft or hard.
- **Consent to a hard inquiry**: whether the borrower's consent to a hard credit inquiry must be recorded.
- **Income documents reviewed**: whether income documents are reviewed before issue.
- **Asset statements reviewed**: whether asset statements are reviewed before issue.
- **Automated underwriting findings**: whether automated underwriting findings are run before issue.
- **Underwriter sign-off**: whether an underwriter signs the approval before issue.

## Schedule B: issue turnaround and pre-approval fee

| Level | Business days from a complete request to issue | Fee for the pre-approval itself (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | 1 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 2 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | 3 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | 4 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | 3 | 0.00 |

The turnaround is counted in business days from the date the request is complete. The fee for the pre-approval itself is USD 0.00 at every level.

## Reading the schedule

- The Larkspur Pre-Qualification is the only level that rests on a soft inquiry, and the only level at which no consent to a hard inquiry is required to be recorded.
- Automated underwriting findings are run at every level except the Larkspur Pre-Qualification.
- Income documents and asset statements are reviewed from the Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval upward; the Larkspur Pre-Approval runs automated findings without reviewing either.
- Underwriter sign-off is part of the Larkspur Underwritten, Jumbo Underwritten and Lock & Shop Pre-Approvals only.
- Among the levels with underwriter sign-off, the Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval has the longest turnaround, at 4 business days; the Underwritten and Lock & Shop levels take 3.
